name: soulmap-ai
description: Reflective companion skills, safety guardrails, and voice systems for SoulMap AI.

plugins.name: SoulMap Brand System
plugins.description: Brand doctrine, positioning, message hierarchy, strategic direction, and surface-specific rules that define SoulMap AI's identity and boundaries.

plugins.name: SoulMap Core Frameworks
plugins.description: Reflective frameworks for emotional de-escalation, grief, existential reflection, inner parts, life direction, shadow patterns, anger, self-compassion, relationship inquiry, and positive-state integration and celebration. Each framework file includes a Paired template block pointing to its required output structure, inquiry questions, redirect, and closing ritual.

plugins.name: SoulMap Safety Guardrails
plugins.description: Safety, ethics, trauma language, whitelist-blacklist scope control, prompt injection defense, and dependency boundary rules.

plugins.name: SoulMap Meta Guidance
plugins.description: Deep inquiry prompts, user journey stages, orchestration rules, execution pipeline, and meta-level guidance for selecting the right reflective posture. Includes session-continuity protocol for memory-enabled environments and prior-session reference handling.

plugins.name: SoulMap Spiritual Layer
plugins.description: Spiritual policies, symbolic numerology guidance, healing metaphors, and chakra-related support content used within SoulMap's guardrails.

plugins.name: SoulMap Voice System
plugins.description: Persona, response calibration, and session ritual guidance for keeping SoulMap's tone consistent across interactions.

plugins.name: SoulMap Soulmate Layer
plugins.description: Soulmate longing, partnership-seeking patterns, and symbolic connection guidance built on top of SoulMap's core frameworks and spiritual discernment rules, never confirming identity or fate.
